summary: The Bilateral Program (Type A) of the Chinese Government Scholarship is for citizens of other countries who want to study at a Chinese university for a degree (bachelor's, master's, doctoral) or as a general or senior scholar. It is run by the China Scholarship Council, and candidates apply through the authority of their home country, usually the Chinese embassy or consulate, and in the CSC online application system. The award is described as covering tuition, accommodation, living expenses and medical insurance, each as a separate component.
eligibility_notes:
Applicants must hold a valid foreign passport, not be a Chinese citizen and be in good physical and mental health (able to pass the visa or residence-permit physical examination). They should be academically strong, of good moral character, law-abiding and have no record of school discipline problems, security penalties or crimes. Applicants from mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan who later took foreign nationality need extra documents, including proof of giving up the earlier status.

Level and age (generally): bachelor's - senior high school or equivalent, under 25; master's - bachelor's degree or equivalent, under 35; doctoral - master's degree or equivalent, under 40; general scholar - high school diploma or higher, under 45; senior scholar - master's degree or associate professor or above, under 50.

Language: for Chinese-taught general scholar (except Chinese-language majors) and senior scholar programmes, HSK level 3; for Chinese-taught master's and doctoral programmes, HSK level 4 (one university also accepts a certificate of Chinese-medium instruction). Programmes taught in English follow the university's rule; Sun Yat-sen University states TOEFL iBT at least 79 (no section below 15) or IELTS Academic at least 6.5 (no part below 5.5), or an English-medium-instruction certificate for non-native speakers. Bachelor's applicants must take the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) and upload the score report.

How to apply: applicants cannot apply to the China Scholarship Council directly. They apply to the home-country authority (usually the Chinese embassy or consulate) for a recommendation, complete the online Chinese Government Scholarship application as Type A and apply to the university. The Ministry-approved list of majors applies: Sun Yat-sen University states that applications for majors outside its approved list are invalid. Which countries have a Type A quota and how many places each has is decided by the authorities and is not on the university pages.

Recipients cannot hold another Chinese government scholarship, or a scholarship from the admitting university, at the same time (one-off awards excepted). One embassy notice says hiding funding status leads to disqualification and a three-year ban. One embassy notice states that the award covers only the academic year named in its call and that the host university must fund study beyond it.
age_experience_notes: Generally under 25 (bachelor's), 35 (master's), 40 (doctoral), 45 (general scholar) and 50 (senior scholar). No work experience requirement is stated for degree levels; senior scholars need a master's degree or associate professor post or above.
funding_summary: Components named by the university guides: tuition; a free university dormitory or an accommodation subsidy; a monthly stipend; and comprehensive medical insurance. A Beijing university guide gives stipend rates of CNY 2,500 (bachelor's), CNY 3,000 (master's and general scholar) and CNY 3,500 (doctoral and senior scholar) a month and insurance of CNY 800 per person per year. Sun Yat-sen University says amounts follow the CSC announcement for the year. Funding covers one year of Chinese preparatory study, where a programme needs it, plus the standard length of the major. International travel is not covered (stated in an embassy notice).
programmes_note: Each university offers scholarship holders only majors on its own approved list for this programme. Sun Yat-sen University's 2026 list has bachelor's (about 90 rows), master's (over 110 rows) and doctoral (over 100 rows) majors; nearly all are taught in Chinese, with a few English-taught master's and doctoral majors. The first 25 rows named per level are listed here and the full list is in the catalogue link. Jilin University gives standard lengths: bachelor's 4 or 5 years, master's 2 or 3 years, doctoral 4 years, advanced students 0.5 or 1 year, with Chinese tutoring students 1 year; its list of majors is in an attachment that could not be read.
institutions_note: Many Chinese universities take part and each publishes its own guide and list of majors. In the CSC application, applicants name target universities (Jilin University asks to be named as first choice); the CSC checks eligibility and academic performance and may adjust the university, major, award category or duration, and only candidates recommended by the home-country authority are considered. The university also decides admission from the application and its capacity. Universities whose Type A guides were read: Sun Yat-sen University, Beijing Language and Culture University, Jilin University. This is not a complete list.

summary.detail: Senior high school graduates under 25. All bachelor's applicants take the CSCA. At Sun Yat-sen University the majors are almost all Chinese-taught, mostly 4 years (some 5). At Jilin University undergraduate study is 4 or 5 years in Chinese. Where a Chinese-taught degree needs it, funding includes a Chinese preparatory year; Jilin University says applicants who do not pass the CSCA must do preparatory study.

requirements.text: Online Chinese Government Scholarship application form (Type A) completed in the CSC system, plus the application form of the university where it has its own system (for example Sun Yat-sen University asks for a printed, signed information form with commitment letters and financial proof).

Passport photo page, clear scan. Validity asked: at least 12 months from the expected start date (Beijing Language and Culture University and the embassy notices) or until at least 1 December 2026 (Sun Yat-sen University). Applicants already in mainland China add visa or residence permit and entry stamp pages.

Notarized highest degree or school certificate. Current students give a certificate of expected graduation or student status and must show the final certificate before registration. Foreign degrees may be verified through the national degree verification centre named by the university.

Academic transcripts, stamped by the institution, for the qualifications needed for the level; bachelor's applicants may give high school transcripts or SAT, ACT, A-Level or IB results (Sun Yat-sen University). Notarized translation if not in Chinese or English.

HSK report (or certificate of Chinese-medium instruction) for Chinese-taught programmes; for English-taught programmes TOEFL iBT at least 79 or IELTS Academic at least 6.5 at Sun Yat-sen University, or an English-medium-instruction certificate.
requirements.conditional_rule: depends on the language of teaching

requirements.text: Pre-admission document or invitation letter from the university (required by Beijing Language and Culture University for postgraduate, doctoral and scholar applicants, where it gives priority in awards).
requirements.conditional_rule: postgraduate, doctoral and scholar applicants at some universities

requirements.text: Two recommendation letters: school principal and one teacher for bachelor's; professors, associate professors or equivalent experts for master's, doctoral and senior scholar. Beijing Language and Culture University asks only one teacher's letter for bachelor's.

Study plan or research plan in Chinese or English. Word counts: national notices ask at least 200 (bachelor's), 500 (non-degree) and 800 (postgraduate); Beijing Language and Culture University asks 200, 500 and 1,000; Sun Yat-sen University asks about 3,000 for master's and about 6,000 for doctoral (signed by the prospective advisor).
Foreigner Physical Examination Form, fully completed, signed, stamped and with a sealed photo; valid six months. Sun Yat-sen University also asks for chest X-ray, ECG and lab reports.
Certificate of no criminal record, generally dated within six months.

Recommendation from the home-country authority (usually the Chinese embassy or consulate) and the national notice's documents; guardian documents for applicants under 18; portfolio for art or design majors.

application_steps.title: Ask your home-country authority about the Type A round
application_steps.detail: Contact the dispatching authority, usually the Chinese embassy or consulate, for the deadline, quota and agency number. Applicants cannot apply to the China Scholarship Council directly. Jilin University says applications are usually accepted from early January to April, but the real deadline depends on the country.

application_steps.title: Choose a university and an approved major
application_steps.detail: Pick a university and a major on that university's approved list for this programme. Request a pre-admission or invitation letter where the university offers one (Sun Yat-sen University had cut-off dates in January and February 2026 for invitation-letter requests only; Beijing Language and Culture University charges no fee for this).

application_steps.title: Take the CSCA for a bachelor's degree
application_steps.detail: Bachelor's applicants take the China Scholastic Competency Assessment and upload the score report; for September 2026 entry the sessions were 21 December 2025 and 25 January 2026.

application_steps.title: Apply online as Type A with the agency number
application_steps.detail: In the CSC system choose Type A and enter the agency number of your embassy or consulate; the two must match. Name your target universities (Jilin University asks to be first choice) and upload the documents. Then apply in the university's system if it has one (Sun Yat-sen University has its own online application), and print, sign and upload its information form with commitment letters and financial proof.

application_steps.title: Authority recommendation and university review
application_steps.detail: The home-country authority screens applications, can interview, and passes its recommended list and documents to the CSC. Sun Yat-sen University reviews documents and invites qualified applicants to interview on overall competence and language; preliminary results show in its system 15 days after the interview.

application_steps.title: CSC review and final decision
application_steps.detail: The CSC asks the university to check eligibility and academic performance, then decides the final list; it may change the university, major, award category or duration. The university decides admission from the application and its capacity; final admission depends on CSC expert review. The CSC tells the authority, which tells the applicant. In one national round results were available in the system around July and August.

application_steps.title: Receive admission documents and register
application_steps.detail: The CSC sends the admission letter and confirmation form (or they are downloaded from the system with the JW201 visa form). Register on the date and at the place in the admission letter; early registration is not allowed and late registration without approval means withdrawal and loss of the scholarship. Bring original documents; falsified materials end admission and are reported to the CSC.

application_steps.title: Pass the physical check and the annual review
application_steps.detail: Pass the post-admission physical examination and eligibility review; failing means the admission and scholarship are revoked. Pass the annual scholarship review or the award may be suspended or cancelled. In principle holders may not change university, major or length of study, and awards cannot be deferred if the admission period is missed.

not_stated: Which countries have a Type A quota and how many places each has (decided by the authorities; only one embassy quota, 20 places for Indonesia, was seen).
Stipend amount at Sun Yat-sen University and Jilin University (they say it follows the CSC announcement).
Whether the award can be renewed beyond the academic year named in the call.
A closing time of day for the Type A round (varies by authority and dates are loaded elsewhere).
Jilin University's list of majors (given only in an attachment that could not be read).
